name: Chebulic Myrobalan + Barberry
pharmacology_description: This is a unique combination of Chebulic Myrobalan (Terminalia chebula), Barberry (Berberis aristata) and other natural ingredients, which helps to relieve haemorrhoid and constipation. It reduces swelling and inflammation of rectal mucosa, acts as mild laxative, prevents undue pressure on rectal muscle. Hanrhoid is very effective in stomachache and flatulence.
dosage_description: 1 tablet twice daily or as prescribed by the physician.
side_effects_description: No significant side effect has been observed in proper dosage.
precautions_description: Keep out of reach of the children.
storage_conditions_description: Store at cool and dry place, protect from light.
